metadata.name: kaigu_gacha
metadata.description: GachaStock: a blind-box protocol for tokenized US stocks on Solana

instructions.name: buy_packs
docs: Takes payment, creates the pack and requests randomness. The full amount stays pending
until the callback, so a timeout can be refunded in full.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The user or a relayer; pays rent and the randomness fee

instructions.name: callback_open
docs: Draw callback. Callable only by the MagicBlock VRF identity; it only updates the ledger and moves no tokens.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Sends the locked USDC to the user minus the settlement fee, closes the Pack and returns its rent.
The frontend can append Jupiter swap instructions in the same transaction to turn the USDC into the pulled stock.

instructions.name: coin_buy
docs: Buys the machine coin with at most `usdc_in` (fee included). Before graduation this
trades on the bonding curve; the purchase that sells the last curve coin graduates the
machine: 4,000 USDC of the raise seeds its prize pool and the rest backs the trading
pool. After graduation it trades against that pool.

instructions.name: coin_sell
docs: Sells machine coins. On the curve this pays the curve price; if the curve missed its
deadline the machine is marked failed and holders sell back along the curve with no
fee. After graduation it trades against the pool.

instructions.name: crank_buyback
docs: Spends accrued buyback funds on the machine coin and burns what it buys. Anyone can
crank it; each call is capped so buybacks land in small pieces.

instructions.name: create_machine
docs: Creates an official machine: open immediately, no machine coin, whole fee to the protocol.

instructions.name: create_season
docs: Publishes a new season and makes it the one new machines are created under.
Published seasons are immutable; existing machines keep their own season.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the Config. Only the program upgrade authority (multisig) may call it.

instructions.name: launch_machine
docs: Launchpad: anyone can launch a machine and its coin. The creator picks the name,
ticker, art and a stock basket from the whitelist; everything else comes from the
template and nothing can be changed afterwards. The coin sells on a bonding curve and
the machine opens once the curve sells out.

accounts.name: coin_mint
docs: The machine coin: a classic SPL token whose only mint authority is the machine.

instructions.name: refund_timeout
docs: If the randomness callback times out, the pack owner gets the full payment back. Not affected by pause.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pauses new purchases, launches and coin buys; claims, refunds and coin sells keep working.

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Pays a machine's accrued fees to their fixed destinations: the protocol's share to the
treasury and the creator's share to the creator. Anyone can crank it. No instruction
can touch the prize pool, locked prizes, pending payments or the coin market's USDC.

errors.name: BadCount
errors.msg: Pull count must be between 1 and 10

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Pack is in the wrong status

errors.name: Insolvent
errors.msg: Prize pool or token balance is insufficient

errors.name: BudgetExceeded
errors.msg: Expected fixed-tier payout must be below the per-pack prize pool inflow

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: This machine coin is not trading

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: Price moved past the slippage limit

errors.name: CreatorCap
errors.msg: The creator's allocation on the curve is used up

errors.name: EarlyCap
errors.msg: Purchase is above the limit for the first blocks after launch

fields.name: reserved
docs: Unused; kept so the account layout stays stable across upgrades.

types.name: Curve
docs: Coin-side state of a launchpad machine's market.

fields.name: sold
docs: Coins sold by the curve and still outstanding (pre-graduation).

fields.name: pool_coins
docs: Coin side of the post-graduation pool. These coins are minted only when bought.

fields.name: burned
docs: Coins removed for good by buybacks.

fields.name: bought_back
docs: USDC spent on buybacks so far.

types.name: Machine
docs: One gacha machine: its own theme, stock basket and prize pool, with its own ledger.
The machine's USDC token account must always hold at least the sum of the ledger fields.

fields.name: theme
docs: Art / colour preset; display only.

fields.name: basket
docs: Indices into the season's stock whitelist.

fields.name: coin_mint
docs: Machine coin mint; default for official machines.

fields.name: market_usdc
docs: USDC backing the machine coin: the curve reserve before graduation, the pool's USDC side after.

fields.name: stock_idx
docs: Index into the season's stock whitelist

types.name: Season
docs: Economic parameters shared by machines. Immutable once published; new parameters need a
new season, and every machine keeps the season it was created under.

fields.name: jackpot_min_pool
docs: The jackpot only pays while the prize pool is at least this large; below it a jackpot
roll is treated as the best fixed tier the pool can afford.

fields.name: whitelist
docs: Stock mints a machine may put in its basket.

fields.name: bonus
docs: Prize-pool payout on top of the floor (USDC base units). Ignored for the jackpot tier.
